newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: BK Vision held 9.0 pct of UBS at end-1996.
newsitem.headline: BK Vision held 9.0 pct of UBS at end-1996.

text.p: Swiss-based investment trust BK Vision said it held around 9.0 percent of Union Bank of Switzerland's registered shares, and 5.3 percent of its bearer shares at the end of 1996.

BK Vision, controlled by investor Swiss financier Martin Ebner, in details presented with its profit and loss statement, said it reported an unusually high 338 million Swiss franc income from trade investments, compared with 77 million in 1995. It said the income resulted mainly from sales of around 2.4 million UBS registered shares.
In the same time period, it said it doubled its holdings of UBS bearer shares.
It also reported no major changes in its holding of Zurich Insurance. At the end of its business year it held 4.9 percent of total shares in Zurich.
It said its market value of both UBS and Zurich Insurance holdings totaled 2.7 billion francs.
In October BK Vision reported its UBS stake at 9.2 percent of the bank's registered shares.
BK Vision is UBS's single largest shareholder.
